title: Washboard Road
description: A dirt road seen straight down from above, corrugating over time. The washboard instability: traffic scrapes grains and throws them a little downstream on every bounce, so faint bumps grow into the regular transverse ripples that rut a gravel road. The lane starts smooth and washboards up until the ripples saturate, then a grader blade sweeps across, scrapes it flat, and the cycle repeats. Regrade on a beat, on the Auto-grade timer, or with the Regrade now button. Traffic speed, formation rate, suspension, scrape, downstream drift, grain slump, road scroll, wheel tracks and dirt hue are live.
